name: Tsetseg Achampong-Solberg
location: The Shelf, near Kedzie and Division

physical_description.build: Lean and corded with functional muscle; the physique of someone who does her own wet work. No excess, all efficiency.
physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with natural black roots, intentionally maintained for the contrast
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled into a tight, functional braid coiled at the base of her skull
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint amber neon threading in the iris—subcutaneous neural interface marker
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with a weathered quality; sun exposure and age have deepened it unevenly
physical_description.complexion: Weathered, angular face with sharp cheekbones and a prominent jaw. Minimal grooming—no cosmetics. Two parallel scars mark her left temple, faded but visible. Her skin has the texture of someone who's spent decades in the GLMZ's variable climate without excessive skincare.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar running from left temple to cheekbone, approximately 8cm, partially obscured by gray hair
Tattoo on inner left wrist: Cyrillic characters spelling 'ВЫХОД' (exit/way out), done in faded black ink, circa 2190s style
Burn scar on right palm and forearm—mottled pink tissue from fingers to elbow, consistent with electrical contact or plasma weapon discharge
Small pockmark scars scattered across both shoulders and upper back, old vaccinations or shrapnel
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right hand replaced from wrist down—matt black synthetic composite with articulated chrome finger joints and visible haptic feedback nodes along the palm. Left eye has a faint luminescent quality when light catches it at certain angles (ocular neural interface). Subcutaneous armor plating visible as faint geometric ridges beneath the skin of her ribs on the right side.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and alert. She moves as though always assessing exits and threats—shoulders slightly forward, weight distributed to the balls of her feet. Her right synthetic hand is never still, micro-adjusting, testing grip. Direct eye contact is constant, almost aggressive. When at rest, there's a coiled quality to her; she doesn't relax, only pauses.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 utilitarian with older-model high-end components. Black reinforced cargo pants (Hegemony tactical cut, circa 2220) with structural webbing at the thighs. Charcoal matte jacket with internal holster rig visible when unbuttoned. Worn Neo-Gen combat boots, re-soled twice. A faded leather wristband on her left arm—older than her augmentations, possibly sentimental. No visible branding; she dresses for function, not status.

image_prompt: A 47-year-old extraction specialist woman, Mongolian-West African-Scandinavian descent, lean and muscled. Steel-gray braided hair pulled tight. Weathered angular face with sharp cheekbones, dark brown eyes with amber neon iris threading. Visible surgical scars on left temple. Matte black synthetic right hand with chrome finger joints replacing wrist. Faded tattoo on inner wrist in Cyrillic characters. Burn scars across right palm and forearm. Black tactical cargo pants, charcoal reinforced jacket, worn combat boots. Coiled posture, alert stance, direct unflinching gaze. Gritty cyberpunk noir aesthetic, dimly-lit underground tier-3 location with cool blue-green neon ambient light. High contrast lighting emphasizing scars and chrome augmentations.
